units.rawText: What happened? Why are they saying your memory needs recovering? What information are you looking for? The Cloud's infrastructure? Persicaria's profile? Or... intel on Griffin?

units.rawText: Relax, I remember all those. I remember everything from the real world.

units.rawText: I see... Hmph, I'm glad that's the case.

units.rawText: ...Why are you looking at me like that? I was just in a hurry because it's my job to protect you, not because of any personal feelings or anything like that...

units.rawText: You've steeled yourself for a tough battle, haven't you? A fight against all odds, even with every trump card in your hand...

units.rawText: Of course, I'm an elite Doll.
units.displayText: Of course, I'm an elite Doll.

spans.text: Of course, I'm an elite Doll.

units.rawText: Leave the other fronts to me—I can handle them on my own just fine. That way, you can mobilize all available forces with nothing to worry about.

units.rawText: Hmph, with all the help I've given you, you'd better win. I won't give you an easy time if you lose.
